notes: No Greek article stands anywhere in the verse, so every English *the* is a supplied determiner and rule 51's anarthrous clause (with rule 58's noun test) keeps it on the noun it determines rather than on any modifier.

υἱοῦ is an expressed relational noun, so rule 52 is not in play: *the son* / *of David* split under rule 26 as independently recoverable pairs, and the second link is analysed identically under rule 24.
